d: Marittima, choir of Nereids and Sirens.
The Feaci cross the sea with their boats, disembark with Ulysses sleeping and leave him at the entrance of the Naiadi cave with his treasure.
Neptune rises from the sea, then Jupiter.
Choir of Feaci at sea, then Neptune.
Minerva in a shepherd's dress, Ulysses.
Eumete, then Ulysses in the form of an old man.
Telemaco and Minerva on the wagon.
Eight Moors come out here, making a Greek dance, sung in the following verses.
Eumete and Penelope, the Proci aside.
Ulysses, then Minerva in master dress.
Pisandro, Anfinomus, Melantus, Antinous, Eumetes, Iro, Ulysses, Penelope.
Desert with Ombre de' proci, Mercury.
Juno, Jupiter, Neptune, Minerva, Choir of Heaven and Maritime Choir.
Ulysses survives in his form, and sayings.
Choir of the Ithaceans, sometimes performed in theatre.(Monteverdi, VIII book of madrigals)
